proves: RFC 0009 2's member-lifecycle syntax `spawn Entity {} in org` is DESCRIBED-BUT-NOT-IMPLEMENTED: spawn has no `in <organization>` child clause, so the expression is a real parse error (exit 3). There is no member map, no child-supervision relation, and no way to spawn a member inside an organization; the desugaring adds nothing beyond the `entity` body grammar plus an `is_organization` metadata flag. (RFC 0009's `named "..."` spawn spelling fails to parse too -- the implemented stable-identity form is `as "..."`, see org_05.)
